verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents a public REST and GraphQL API with SDKs (appwrite-docs-70), file APIs (appwrite-docs-10), and project and resource management through that API via the CLI, including headless use in CI (appwrite-docs-12, appwrite-docs-42). An official MCP server lets LLMs call the API directly (appwrite-docs-11, appwrite-docs-56), and docs are machine-readable through llms.txt and .md pages (appwrite-probe-1, appwrite-docs-40). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API end-to-end.
